nominal_current_conversion.provenance: MAX30102 LED pulse-amplitude nominal scale used by the existing Stage 9 profiles

physical_controls.right_hand_sensor_location: flat at Z23 between the second and third metacarpals
physical_controls.placement_between_attempts: RIGHT-hand sensor, hand, forearm, and supported leads remain unchanged unless a stop condition requires removal
physical_controls.ambient_condition: stable indoor ambient light with no added cover, shade, or lighting change
physical_controls.ambient_change_policy: retain the affected attempt and stop; do not replace it automatically

reference.label: HOME_CUFF_PULSE_REFERENCE_BPM
reference.interpretation: reference label only; not beat-level ground truth, a validated sensor output, a diagnosis, or BP ground truth
reference.start_instruction: Press cuff START within two seconds of START CUFF NOW. The acquisition runner waits four seconds, starts PPG, and the retained 30-second window begins after the 100-pair active preflight, nominally about five seconds after the cue.
reference.timestamps: retain actual cue UTC, PPG window UTC, displayed pulse, and exact cuff completion UTC when observed; never reconstruct a missing time

predeclared_comparison.eligibility: A profile is policy-seed eligible only when calibration review passes and ACQ-01 retains exactly 3000 ordered pairs with zero clipping, zero FIFO overflow, verified identity/config/session/timing, and a passing active preflight.
predeclared_comparison.primary_channel_comparison: Because RED is fixed, compare IR headroom, DC/AC behavior, drift_bounded_cardiac_snr_db, dominant_frequency_stability.consistency_score, and absolute difference between 60*IR dominant_hz and the home-cuff pulse label.
predeclared_comparison.secondary_checks: Record the same RED fields and RED/IR cardiac-band agreement to expose placement/time drift; do not treat raw correlation, pSNR, a positive spectrum score, or cuff agreement alone as proof of pulse.
ranking_order: absence of clipping/overflow and adequate headroom
same-profile contact separation and preflight stability
RED stability as a fixed-channel confound indicator

stop_conditions: pain, unusual heat, blanching, lasting indentation, or discomfort
sensor, hand, forearm, lead, cuff, lighting, or placement movement or uncertainty
identity, configuration, session, calibration, timing, or reference uncertainty
clipping, FIFO overflow, packet loss, malformed/duplicate/out-of-order data, disconnect, or persistence failure
